discussion_comments.comment_body: Real, but not specific to this page, so leaving it for a follow-up. A model switch inside an open chat only sends the new model id, and the SDK's `updateSessionConnection` keeps the session's existing `providerConfig`. That already happens when someone edits a provider's context window in BYOK mid-chat; Use with Cline just makes it easier to hit. Ollama gets the window with every request (`num_ctx`), so in practice this affects LM Studio chats that switch to a model with a smaller window. A new chat picks up the right window. The proper fix is for the SDK to work out the context window again when the model changes, which we'll do separately instead of rebuilding provider config in the Desktop chat send path here.

Model changes between turns are supported. The [cloud picker restricts providers to Cline](https://github.com/cline/cline/blob/5da3e3e4e7e610238517edb07a14f21a261f030c/apps/examples/desktop-app/webview/components/views/chat/chat-input-bar.tsx#L1608-L1616), and the sidecar [updates the attached Hub session with the selected model](https://github.com/cline/cline/blob/5da3e3e4e7e610238517edb07a14f21a261f030c/apps/examples/desktop-app/sidecar/cloud-sessions.ts#L1520-L1538). The existing [model-update test](https://github.com/cline/cline/blob/5da3e3e4e7e610238517edb07a14f21a261f030c/apps/examples/desktop-app/sidecar/cloud-sessions.test.ts#L239-L289) verifies that `session.update_connection` runs before `session.send_input`.

`autoCorrectModel={false}` prevents automatic catalog correction of an attached session's model. Explicit user selection between turns is intentional; disabling it would remove supported behavior.
